LENG.description: Effective/Unbraced Length (LENG). All fields describe member unbraced lengths and calculation options; every field is optional.

LY.description: Unbraced Length Ly (for in-plane buckling about the strong axis).

LZ.description: Unbraced Length Lz (for out-of-plane buckling about the weak axis).

LB.description: Laterally Unbraced Length (Lb) for lateral-torsional buckling.

bNOTUSE.description: Do not consider the laterally unbraced length.

bAUTOCALC.description: Calculate the unbraced lengths automatically by the design code.
